evals.name: review-manuscript
evals.prompt: 请对这篇期刊稿件进行同行评审：latex/main.tex。请给出结构化的评审报告，包含摘要声明、主要意见和次要意见。
evals.expected_output: The skill should route to the article review framework and produce a structured peer review report: summary statement with recommendation, numbered major comments with concrete solutions, numbered minor comments, and questions to the author. Tone should be constructive and professional.

evals.name: review-nsfc
evals.prompt: 请帮我评审这份国家自然科学基金申请书（NSFC），文件是 proposal.docx。给出四大核心部分（立项依据、研究内容与目标、研究方案、创新特色）的评估和改进建议。
evals.expected_output: The skill should route to the NSFC proposal review framework and evaluate the four core parts (立项依据, 研究内容与目标, 研究方案及可行性, 创新特色), following the funding-tier conclusion standard (优先资助/可资助/不予资助) and providing concrete improvement suggestions.

evals.name: evaluate-survey
evals.prompt: 请给这篇无线通信综述文章打分（满分100分）：survey.md。
evals.expected_output: The skill should route to the survey evaluation framework and apply the 7-dimension, 100-point rubric, providing per-dimension scores with bands and justification, a total score, and a written evaluation report with strengths, weaknesses, and improvement suggestions.
